verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a SaaS AI code-review service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no region or residency selection. The privacy-security page covers only model-training commitments, SOC 2 Type 1 and blocking AI features, which are adjacent privacy controls that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
